lib/analytics/dashboards/surveillance.ts.reason: TWO audited non-scope references, both re-audited 2026-07-26 when C3 (ONE VIEWSCOPE) migrated the other 52 into dashboards/_scope.ts. (1) fetchCasesPerSubregion's `eq(cases.jurisdictionProvince, provinceDisplayName)` — the MAP's SUBJECT selector (which province's subregions to render), not a viewer-scope gate: the real scope is casesScopeClause(actor, jurisdictions, adminProvince, adminLocality), AND-ed alongside it in the same conditions array, so this predicate can only ever NARROW. Routing it through a scope helper would be wrong: for govt the helper ignores an admin drill by design, and this filter must apply to govt too.
